clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Johaan tests his pumpkin weapon in Brill. He has laced pumpkins from Solliden Farmstead with his latest alchemical concoction and sends you to feed one to a captive Scarlet Crusader.

Apothecary Johaan believes the Forsaken must use every advantage against the Scourge to the north and human incursions to the south. The Royal Apothecary Society looks beyond blades and dark sorcery, seeking weapons in the ordinary produce of the land. Johaan has tainted pumpkins gathered from the mortal farmers at Solliden Farmstead. He means to prove common crops can be made deadly in service of the Dark Lady.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath.
With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat.
Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern. Take this pumpkin to the fool.

clips.title: Completion
